$schema-note: Shared, append-only registry of reserved spec-number ranges. One row per fork, keyed by its origin repo. A fork reserves a band by opening a PR that appends one row; rows never overlap. Tooling (scripts/next-spec-number.ts) and scripts/docs-lint.ts read this file so each fork only ever mints spec numbers inside its own band. Optional per-row "policy" selects a band-local minting strategy; absent/unknown => the default max-in-band+1, "reserve-overlaps" => fill gaps and hold the lowest-available slots open as renumber targets for any duplicated numbers.
